scheme.canonical: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted by code point, separators ',' and ':', no ASCII escaping
scheme.signature: Ed25519 over the canonical bytes, raw standard base64 without padding
scheme.signed_payload: base64url without padding of the canonical bytes
scheme.tool: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$, at most 64 bytes; required when phase is tool, optional otherwise
scheme.summary: optional; 1 to 120 UTF-8 bytes; no control characters (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F)
scheme.seq: a JSON integer from 1 to 2^53-1 (not a float, not a boolean)
scheme.session_id: required key; null, or a lowercase hyphenated UUID
scheme.caller: the authenticated request: signer_did is the key that signed the request (the agent's did:key, or the grant session did:key for a grant caller), stable_id the identity it is attributed to (null when it has none), team_id its authenticated team. A case without caller uses default_caller.
scheme.bindings: the signature is verified with caller.signer_did; from_did must equal it; team_id must equal caller.team_id; from_stable_id, when present, must equal caller.stable_id
scheme.ordering: size is checked before parsing, canonical bytes before the signature, the signature before fields, type before any other field, field shapes before caller bindings, and bindings before time; every other negative has exactly one fault

route_refusals.name: session_absent
route_refusals.description: valid[0] presented by its caller when no chat session has its session_id

route_refusals.name: session_not_participant
route_refusals.description: valid[0] presented by its caller when the session exists but the caller is not a participant; byte-identical to session_absent

cross_type.name: activity_payload_under_message_verification
cross_type.description: Message verification rebuilds the canonical payload from SIGNED_FIELDS only. For an activity document that keeps from_did, from_stable_id, timestamp and type, whose bytes differ from the signed activity bytes, so the activity signature does not verify as a message.
